description: Election Commission - Declare that K. R. Chandrasekara as a member of the Seethawaka Urban Council, and K. Mohanadass as a member of the Matale Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government councils (Seethawakapura Urban Council and Matale Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, including the declaration of elected members to fill seats that became vacant due to party membership changes. This falls squarely under election-related matters, specifically addressing candidate nominations and declarations following electoral procedures.
